input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `busy` state is only reset in the `.then()` callback of `exportReport`, which is never called if the export fails. Move the `setBusy(false)` call into a `.catch()` handler to ensure the button is re-enabled after a failed export, allowing users to retry without a page reload.

input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `busy` state is only reset in the `.then()` callback of `exportReport`, which is never called if the export fails. Move the `setBusy(false)` call into a `.catch()` handler to ensure the button is re-enabled after a failed export, allowing users to retry without a page reload.
